name: plumbing_persistence
description: Test 23: the size example of 9: 64 x 64 cells, 2 producers, no current producer (after a complete pass), 3 pipes, all references non-null: 2 + 16 + 8 + 4096 + 4 + 4 + 8 + 4 + 4 + 80 + 36 + 29 + 8 + 12 + 24 + 8 + 32 = 4375 bytes. Layout spot checks: version 04 00 at 0; countX = countZ = 64 at 18; the flag map from 26 in index order z x 64 + x: (5,5) = 0x20 (pump lot) at 26 + 325, (6,5) = 0x15 (pipe connected both ways) at 352; passCounter 1 at 26 + 4096 = 4122; field 14 (the scanning iterator) at 4122 + 4 + 8 + 4 + 4 + 80 + 36 = 4262: done (02), x 0, z 64 (= countZ, the rest position after a pass, 6.6 PL4; it was 63 before the spec answer), step 1, rectangle 0, 0, 63, 63. Write -> Read -> Write is byte-identical. The loaded simulator has state 0 (a pass starts at once), grids-initialized set, numPipes 3, its producers in file order with production kept; its Init creates no grids and no department but removes line item 1 [compat]; a pass after the load publishes the same values as before the save: the pump cell (5,5) = 7 (lot 2 | producer-only 4 | watered 1) and the house (12,5) = 2 (not watered: the seed cell (5,5) holds only 0x20, no direction bit, so the flood never enters the pipes, 6.2). Version 3 -> Read returns false at once and reads nothing; the store ignores the result (store 3.5), so the simulator stays as created (no grids, no pipes, no producers, counters 0).
